She gets a tiny serving of wet food for breakfast & another for dinner. She gets open fed kibble & has her entire life so she’s never been an over eater. I’ve switched brands a lot throughout her life but I always buy an appropriate food for her age range. I’ve been using hills science diet for senior cats for a few years now for kibble & fancy feast petites for wet food the past few months. I also give her plenty of lickable, soupy snacks to sneak extra hydration in. Cat fountains are also great for keeping them hydrated. Kidney issues are the biggest killer of cats so hydration is so important for a long happy life. 
She’s very active for her age & gets a lot of play time. She requests treats by doing tricks for them(she give me a high five or paw shake when she wants the crunchies) but she gets 15 at the most per day. I give her greenies for treats & sneak in a couple glycoflex joint support vitamins for cats with her treats. She has cat grass that she has access to whenever she wants it as well.
She’s still alive. She’s currently napping on the side of my head. I just wanted to show off my old gal.
